action.name: Multiattack
entries: The boneclaw makes two Piercing Claw attacks.

action.name: Piercing Claw (Reach 15 ft.)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d10 + 4}) piercing damage. Target is pulled up to 15 ft. and is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}).

action.name: Shadow Jump {@recharge 5}
entries: Creatures within 5 feet take 34 ({@damage 5d12 + 2}) necrotic damage ({@dc 14} Con save for half). Teleports up to 60 ft bringing one grappled creature.

reaction.name: Deadly Reach
entries: When an enemy moves into its 15 ft. reach, it makes one Piercing Claw attack, and a second if the first hits.
